name: the-last-docx
description: Integrated DOCX, PPTX, and XLSX inspection and editing modules with explicit artifact verification.

interface.longDescription: Preserves the DOCX module contracts and adds mature open-source-backed PPTX and XLSX modules using an immutable artifact store and bounded operations.
defaultPrompt: 检查 Office 运行环境及 DOCX、PPTX、XLSX 模块能力。
解析 DOCX 并保留可编辑的双 IR 锚点。
检查或编辑 PPTX / XLSX，并校验新产物。
